name: High-resolution body imagery over SDN
description: High-resolution global imagery of a body as a 256 px JPEG tile pyramid published over SDN. First source: Mars, the USGS Astrogeology THEMIS Day IR global mosaic 100 m v12 (NASA/JPL/ASU, public domain), read once per cycle by HTTP range (If-Match on its ETag, never held whole): level 9 (81.4 m/px) area-averaged from the source rows, every coarser level the 2x2 mean of the level below, planetocentric latitude for the MOLA-sphere globe, packs of 16 tiles of a row (SDNTILE1) added to the node's IPFS and filed as $PNM (PNM.fbs, provider usgs-astrogeology, source mars-themis-day-ir) by storage.ingest_with_source, one batch per band of 16 level-9 rows (one level-5 tile row).

sequentialJustification.detail: Host calls in turn (one ranged GET per level-9 tile row, ipfs.add per pack, one ingest per band); the resample, the 2x2 pyramid and the JPEG encoder are single-threaded passes over one row per level held in linear memory.

Two FlowNotices Info, REASON filed: SOURCE_NAME angular-g13.5 (COUNT tiles filed; ITEMS tiles, stars, gaia, hipparcos_only, bright_edsd, range_splits, strays, patched_tiles, outside_sky, tap_queries, tap_bytes, seconds) and octree-g13.5 (COUNT nodes filed; ITEMS nodes, stars, depth, max_float32_error_per_edge, seconds).

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice: files, tiles, bytes, largest pack, source bytes read, seconds.
